evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast receipt and watched extraction appeals to stability/security of the system and the mastery of its design.
The appeal to no lost work is a security/stability value — the system preserves what matters even under failure conditions.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The agent choosing between polling or receiving piggybacked results appeals to self-directed cadence (autonomy) while the non-blocking design preserves system stability (conservation).
